newProject.title: New project
newProject.name: Name
newProject.comicHint: Starts with the Comic panel (panels and speech bubbles) open.
newProject.hybrid3dHint: Starts with the 3D viewer (camera, lights, pose) open to import a model.

export.title: Export image

formats.webpNote: Usually ~30% lighter than PNG at similar quality.
formats.avifNote: Usually ~50% lighter than PNG. Newer format, less compatible.
formats.bmpNote: No compression — meant for compatibility with legacy software.
formats.tiffNote: No compression, with alpha channel — for professional printing.
formats.psdNote: With layers (name, opacity, visibility and blend mode) to open in Photoshop, Krita or Clip Studio. Doesn't include masks, adjustments or layer styles.
formats.pdfNote: One page at the physical size given by the project's DPI (for printing or sending). With "lossless" the file is bigger.

export.vectorize: Vectorize (editable shapes, one SVG layer per layer)
export.vectorHint: This is an automatic trace: gradients turn into flat color bands, partial transparency becomes opaque (each layer's own opacity is kept), and fine texture is lost.
export.flatSvgHint: The flattened image wrapped in an SVG: works anywhere, but the shapes aren't editable.

resize.title: Resize (smart)
resize.description: Removes or duplicates the least detailed strips of pixels instead of scaling everything uniformly (seam carving). Flattens all layers into one.
resize.seamsWarning: {{count}} seams to process — this can take several seconds.

autoSave.title: Automatic backups
autoSave.hint: These backups are kept separately, without overwriting your file — restoring one requires "Save as" to keep it.
autoSave.restoredToast: "{{name}}" restored — use "Save as" to keep it

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.intro: Tell me what happened or what's on your mind. It's sent exactly as you see it here — nothing sends itself.
feedback.placeholder: What happened, or what do you want to tell me?
feedback.includeThumb: Include a thumbnail of what I was drawing
feedback.sendHint: If "Email" or "Gmail" don't open anything, copy or save it and send it however you prefer.
feedback.emailTitle: Opens your email client — if nothing happens when you click, you probably don't have one set up; try Gmail next to it
feedback.gmailTitle: Opens a new email in Gmail, in the browser — works even without any email client set up
feedback.subject: Feedback about SCHIZZO STUDIO
feedback.autoContext: An automatic failure was detected in "{{name}}". If you want, tell me what you were doing when it happened — or just hit Save or Copy.
feedback.attachThumbNote: Also attach the thumbnail you just saved/copied — this doesn't include it on its own.

updateNotice.upToDateToast: You already have the latest version.
